system.description:
You generate a discharge of lightning from your body, which takes any shape of your description before deciding on a target to strike as quick as lightning.

Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack against a creature in range. On a hit, you deal 3d10 Lightning damage and force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they are Dazed. If this attack is made targeting a Grappled or Chilled creature, they suffer a -1 penalty to their saving throw.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the impact of this jutsu can send a creature into Stupor on a failed save, instead of Daze, at your choice.
